# X Impact Simulator (full)

> Experimental / prior-mapped, not empirically calibrated. Uses selected public X ranking defaults, not the live Phoenix model or graph.

## Scoring

`score = offset(sum(w_i * P(action_i)))`, then out-of-network x 0.75.

The headline impact score blends 35% equal-profile prior with 65% median population/ranking simulation score. This lets sampled prevalence, candidate competition, network status, and cascade path affect the result while retaining a lower-variance prior anchor. It is not empirically calibrated.

Source checked: xai-org/x-algorithm public main on 2026-09-04; param.rs says its defaults mirror was synced 2026-08-12. NEGATIVE_SCORES_OFFSET = 0.001. Affinities are mapped through assumed impression-level priors before both scoring and event sampling. UI 0-100 is a sigmoid of that prior-mapped raw score, not clamp(raw / 6). p10–p90 are final-cascade Monte Carlo scores; the shown graph is the run nearest median exposure/score.

BluePrint training labels favorite, reply, retweet, quote, follow_author, and block_author with actor-grouped evaluation and a text-inferred cluster feature. Runtime uses only validated favorite and retweet heads as persona-preserving content lifts; share, dwell, click, mute, and report stay heuristic/Groq until labeled.

The cascade uses independent compatible actions, explicit synthetic author-network relationships, and synthetic candidate-slate competition. It does not reproduce live retrieval, user history, author diversity, VMRanker, visibility filtering, or runtime experiments.

## Datasets

- ComplexDataLab/BluePrint (MIT, gated): next-action threads, config 25_clusters
- nvidia/Nemotron-Personas-USA (CC BY 4.0): persona diversity; no sex/age/zip targeting
- Salesforce/SCOPE-Persona (CC BY-NC): research only, not production training
- No live For You / Thunder crawl

## Stack

Next.js :3000, FastAPI :8000, Groq optional (Qwen vision, Whisper, text JSON).

## Contact / limits

Do not treat scores as X production or a virality guarantee. Do not use this product to optimize harassment, manipulation, or platform abuse.
